verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents Chargebee syncing invoices, payments, or recognition entries to QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or any other GL/ERP. RevRec's ASC 606 compliance and the async Export resource are adjacent features: exports are exactly the file-based workflow the story wants to avoid. The axis clearly applies to a billing product, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a finance lead, invoices, payments, and recognition entries sync to my general ledger or ERP — QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite — so the close doesn't need CSV surgery
